title: Third Texas Senate poll in a week shows Talarico ahead of Ken Paxton
shortDescription: A new Texas Southern University poll gives Talarico a 2-point edge over Paxton, the third survey in a week to show the Democrat ahead in the race.

title: The House and Senate, both led by Republicans, are openly at odds
shortDescription: Congressional Republicans are struggling to wrangle their slim majorities to get on the same page about the SAVE Act, defense spending and more.

title: Michigan Senate a key race to watch in 5 state primaries Aug. 4
shortDescription: Aug. 4 primaries in Michigan, Virginia, Kansas, Washington and Missouri will test Trump's endorsement power and shape control of Congress.

title: Speaker Johnson on House Republicans Farm Bill
shortDescription: House Speaker Mike Johnson says that House Republicans delivered major legislation, passing the Farm Bill for the first time since 2018.

title: 25 Democrat-led states sue President Trump over new tariffs
shortDescription: Democratic-led U.S. states sue the Trump administration, arguing he exceeded his authority in imposing tariffs on goods from 60 countries.

title: Trump says oil industry 'making too much money' during Iran war
shortDescription: President Trump called out the nation's two largest oil companies, accusing ExxonMobil and Chevron of "making too much money" during the Iran war.

shortDescription: President Trump criticized ExxonMobil and Chevron for soaring profits during the Iran war.

title: 'She choked.' Trump slams Pirro after DOJ drops Reflecting Pool case
shortDescription: “I was disappointed with Jeanine Pirro. Really disappointed with Jeanine Pirro," Trump told reporters Aug. 3. "She folded like an umbrella.”

title: Trump says he wants to give Iran every last chance
shortDescription: President Donald Trump told reporters that he's hoping to make a deal with Iran because he wants to give Iran "every last chance before decapitation."

shortDescription: Pete Buttigieg says he's "more inclined than not" to run for president in 2028, offering his clearest signal yet of another potential White House bid.

title: Trump cancels Iran attack for deal, he says
shortDescription: President Donald Trump said he halted a "massive" military strike against Iran, citing requests from Iran and allies to pursue a deal instead.

title: Blanche pulls DOJ fund before key vote
shortDescription: Todd Blanche rescinded a DOJ fund ahead of a Senate vote, addressing concerns that delayed his confirmation process.
